arguments.notes:
DATABASE: PostgreSQL (information_schema works; sqlite_master does not). Schema public, 8 tables, ALL identifiers are UPPERCASE and must be double-quoted (e.g. "APINVH"). NO declared PK/FK/unique constraints (information_schema.table_constraints is empty), so every relationship below is inferred and was checked in the data.

ROW COUNTS: APINVH 804, APPAYM 538, APVEND 24, GLCOA 10, GLJRNH 1494, GLJRNL 3541, GLPERD 12, SYSDICT 35.

TABLES / COLUMNS
- SYSDICT(TBL_NM, COL_NM, DESCR): the data dictionary, with one row per column of the 7 other tables. It has no entry for itself.
- APVEND(VEND_CD char, VEND_NM text, ACTV_FLG char): vendor master, 24 vendors V0001..V0024, all ACTV_FLG='Y'.
- APINVH(INV_ID int, VEND_CD char, INV_NO text, INV_DT int YYYYMMDD, INV_AMT numeric(2dp), STAT_CD char, JRNL_NO int): AP invoice header.
- APPAYM(PAY_ID int, INV_ID int, PAY_DT int YYYYMMDD, PAY_AMT numeric): payments.
- GLCOA(ACCT_CD char, ACCT_NM, ACCT_TYP text, ACTV_FLG): chart of accounts, 10 accounts. 1000 Operating Cash and 1200 Prepaid (ASSET); 2000 AP Control and 2100 Accrued Liabilities (LIABILITY); 5100 Office Supplies, 5200 Professional Fees, 5300 Facilities, 5400 Software, 5500 Travel, and 5900 Legacy Miscellaneous (EXPENSE, ACTV_FLG='N', retired).
- GLJRNH(JRNL_NO int, PRD_ID int, POST_DT int YYYYMMDD, POST_FLG char, REF_JRNL_NO int nullable, SRC_CD char, SRC_REF text, MEMO text): journal header.
- GLJRNL(JRNL_NO, LN_SEQ, ACCT_CD char, DR_AMT numeric, CR_AMT numeric): journal lines.
- GLPERD(PRD_ID int, STRT_DT, END_DT, CLOSE_DT int YYYYMMDD, STAT_CD char): 12 monthly periods of 2024.

RELATIONSHIPS (inferred; zero orphans found in every check)
- APINVH.VEND_CD -> APVEND.VEND_CD
- APINVH.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO. This is 1:1, and the header's POST_DT equals INV_DT for every invoice.
- APPAYM.INV_ID -> APINVH.INV_ID. Each paid invoice has exactly one payment.
- GLJRNL.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO. Every header has lines, and (JRNL_NO, LN_SEQ) is unique.
- GLJRNL.ACCT_CD -> GLCOA.ACCT_CD
- GLJRNH.PRD_ID -> GLPERD.PRD_ID
- GLJRNH.REF_JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (self-reference used for reversals).
- Payments have no FK to the GL. Each payment has its own AP journal, with SRC_REF='PAY-<PAY_ID>' and MEMO='Payment <INV_NO>' (538 such headers). It is linked by text only.
- Invoice journals have SRC_REF = INV_NO and MEMO 'Invoice <INV_NO>'.
- There is no AR or ledger-balance table.

CONVENTIONS
- Dates are integers in YYYYMMDD form, not date types. GLPERD.CLOSE_DT is NULL for open periods. The probe output showed it as the string "NULL", so check whether it is a real NULL or the literal text.
- Amounts are numeric with 2 decimals. GL lines are unsigned: a line carries either DR_AMT or CR_AMT, with the other 0. No negatives, NULLs or both-sided lines were found. All 3541 lines are accounted for under that rule, and the sign is carried by the column.
- Invoice and payment amounts are positive, except for credit memos (see below).
- The CHAR columns are blank-padded: VEND_CD is 8 characters (e.g. 'V0004   ') and ACCT_CD is 8 characters. In the information_schema probe, lengths showed as 4 or 5, which is char length trimmed. Compare after trimming, or against the padded literal. Joins between same-typed columns work.
- Typical AP posting:
  - Invoice journal: DR expense 5100–5500, CR 2000 AP Control.
  - Payment journal: DR 2000, CR 1000 Cash.
  - GL source journals are manual accruals: DR expense, CR 1200 Prepaid and 2100 Accrued, usually in 2 or 3 lines.
- CR 1000 total 6.61M, against DR 2000 on the same journals of 6.62M.

CODES (confirmed in the data)
- APINVH.STAT_CD: O (266) and P (538). V (void) is documented but has zero rows. Paid (P) matches an APPAYM row one-to-one, and open (O) has no payments.
- GLJRNH.POST_FLG: all 1494 are 'P'. 'U' is documented but unused.
- GLJRNH.SRC_CD: AP (1342) and GL (152).
- GLPERD.STAT_CD: C for periods 1–10 and O for 11–12.
- ACTV_FLG: Y/N. Only GLCOA 5900 is N.
- GLJRNH.SRC_REF: documented as 'Name of the user who keyed the entry'. It actually holds the user for GL journals only (JSMITH, KWONG, MPATEL, RLOPEZ) and the invoice number or PAY-id for AP journals.

ANOMALIES / THINGS TO AUDIT
1. Dictionary errors:
   - It says VEND_CD and ACCT_CD are "space padded to 8 characters". They are fixed-width CHAR, padded to 8, so the claim is roughly right, but SRC_REF and INV_NO text fields are not padded.
   - SRC_REF is described as user name only (see above).
   - STAT_CD 'V' and POST_FLG 'U' are documented but never occur.
   - The dictionary does not mention that REF_JRNL_NO exists as a reversal link, and does not mention that credit memos exist.
2. Unbalanced journal: JRNL_NO 1406 (AP, period 1) has DR 1573.46 against CR 1537.46, a 36.00 difference. It looks like a transposition. It is the only unbalanced journal of 1494.
3. Credit memo: INV_ID 802, INV_NO 'V0008-68658-532-CM', INV_AMT -9051.61, status O, journal 2491. This is the only non-positive invoice. It is booked as a CR to expense 5300 for 9051.61.
4. Retired account in use: 5900 Legacy Miscellaneous (ACTV_FLG='N') has exactly one posting, a DR of 613.18 on an AP journal.
5. Payment amount differs from invoice amount for 1 invoice (the payment is not equal to INV_AMT); identify it via APPAYM join to APINVH.
6. Posting date outside its period: 1 header has a POST_DT outside the STRT_DT..END_DT of its PRD_ID.
7. Posting after close: 1 header has a POST_DT later than its period's CLOSE_DT.
8. Journals numbered above 2400 (81 of them) are in closed periods, so check whether they were entered after the periods closed. Journal numbers range 1000–2493.
9. Manual accrual 2426 (period 4, KWONG, DR=CR=4978.23) was reversed by JRNL 2490 (period 5, REF_JRNL_NO=2426, memo 'Reversal of accrual 2426'). This is the only header with REF_JRNL_NO, even though 151 GL journals carry the memo 'Manual accrual'. GL manual accruals 152 in total, and the reversal is the only recorded one, so the other accruals look un-reversed. The reversal journal carries a CR of 4978.23 on expense 5400.
10. One SRC_REF has a leading space (' V0020-75786-602'), a data-quality issue that would break exact-match joins to INV_NO.
11. Amounts on 1200 and 2100 in GL journals differ slightly (DR 2489.12 vs 2489.11, CR 317365.47 vs 317364.72), indicating those two accounts do not net exactly, although each journal is mostly balanced; tie out per journal. Total across all journals is out of balance by the 36.00 on 1406 and rounding on those lines. Check the totals.
12. Memo and SRC_REF text fields are free text. No instruction-like content was seen in what was sampled, but the sample was partial (output was truncated) and the last queries hit the limit, so not everything was examined.

NOT VERIFIED (query budget ran out): the specific identity of the payment-amount mismatch, of the out-of-period post date, and of the post-close entry; the nature of the 81 late-numbered journals; whether CLOSE_DT NULL is a true NULL.
